name: license-compliance-gate
description: SBOM/license compliance gate for Node projects — scans dependencies with license-checker, normalizes and diffs them with foss-notices-viewer, and enforces a configurable license policy in CI.
author: Amitt K Sharma

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan . --out compliance-report.json --no-fail && cat compliance-report.json
scripts.release:dry: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && commit-and-tag-version --dry-run
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && commit-and-tag-version
